items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: This bulletin addresses a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe fixed it on October 13, 2026, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (September isolated patch)
items.summary: This regular September bulletin addresses eight vulnerabilities, six of which are exploitable without authentication, including critical stored cross-site scripting flaws. It also reminds merchants to apply the StyleSmuggler hotfix.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: An out-of-band emergency hotfix was released for this critical zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and was actively exploited in the wild. All versions from 2.4.4 up to and including 2.4.9 were affected.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (Customer account takeover among seven flaws)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses seven flaws, including a critical vulnerability that could lead to customer account takeover. It was published as part of Adobe's regular security updates.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (14 flaws; first month-stamped releases)
items.summary: This bulletin fixed 14 flaws, with eight rated critical, including an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVE-2026-48356, CVSS 9.6) that allows arbitrary code execution and has been added to CISA's list of exploited vulnerabilities.
